runs.box: OUT AT Q1 (a start-up in substance: no commercial operations, no revenue since 2021 worth the name, going-concern doubt; computation only beneath the stop)
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order, unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, from scratch. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence and competitors derived by the analyst from the 10-K. **Dispatcher's slip in the brief:** the company line called the Lion Energy deal a potential acquisition in the 10-Q to 2026-06-30; that 10-Q's Note 3 says the term sheet was terminated (2026-05-11); the analyst found it and followed the filing. Price **$1.45** (2026-10-29, live quote via tools/run.py, aggregator, flagged) x **3,563,531 common shares** (10-Q cover to 2026-06-30, accession 0001437749-26-025091, as of 2026-07-24; single class; 4,126 treasury shares on the balance sheet) = cap **$5.17M**; sovereign **5.37%** (US Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-28). Filings: 10-K FY2025 0001437749-26-010705, 10-K/A 0001437749-26-014205 (Part III), 10-Q 0001437749-26-025091, DEF 14A 0001437749-26-023053, 8-Ks 0001437749-26-003828, 0001437749-26-028733, 0001437749-26-029824, S-8 0001437749-26-028747; FY2025 operating cash $(10,253)K cross-checked against the filed statement. **Q1 OUT**: a start-up in substance on its own filings ("has not yet commenced large-scale commercial lithium-ion battery recycling operations", 10-K; "has not generated revenues from commercial operations", 10-Q); revenue about $2M to $5M a year 2017 to 2019 from the lead demonstration plant, $0.03M in 2023, nil in 2024 and 2025; 11 employees; going-concern doubt; the plan changed three times in five years (lead to lithium, a narrower product slate in 2025, the Lion Energy energy-storage deal); TRIC commercial facility abandoned with a $9.1M impairment. Q2 to Q12 NOT REACHED. Balance sheets 2016 to 2026-06-30: assets $71.5M to $12.6M, equity $57.0M to $9.5M, accumulated deficit -$28.3M to -$278.9M against $288.4M paid in; no borrowings at 2026-06-30; cash $4.7M against $6.5M operating cash used in the half-year. Facts after the stop, recorded not judged: about $4.1M advanced to Lion Energy, in default, its senior loan assigned to an entity the company believes may be affiliated with a Lion Energy owner, 60% reserved; the same $2.1M described three ways (note purchase in the 10-K cash flows, "product previously delivered" in the 8-K, "short-term financing" in the 10-Q), not reconciled; CEO pay $1.869M for 2025 including a $610K bonus against a $22.6M loss; weighted shares 641,960 (2024) to 1,494,502 (2025) after both reverse splits, 3.56M now, a $50M ATM, a $10M equity line, the 2025 registered direct offering with warrants, 750,000 shares added to the stock plan 2026-08-21 (the box line carries "integrity facts recorded, not judged"). Competitors: the 10-K names none (smelting and unnamed hydrometallurgy developers only); not reached. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash after every real cost (stock pay and capital spending deducted) 2021 -$11.61M, 2022 -$17.17M, 2023 -$11.32M, 2024 -$24.29M, 2025 -$12.94M (-$13.20M with $261K of stock issued for services, which tools/run.py did not add), average -$15.47M, negative every year; specific (b), the no-growth case alone; value range -$77.95 a share all-equity, -$80.82 equity-only; fair price not positive, -$41.26 all-equity (central), -$43.40 equity-only; reported as none. Could not get: Forms 4 of 2026-08-26 and 2026-10-15; the 10-Q's subsequent events for net debt; the Lion Energy description discrepancy. Framework gaps for the operator: Q1 lists start-ups as OUT but sends nascent, fast-moving fields to TOO HARD, and this name is both, with no rule for which governs and no definition of start-up for a twelve-year-old company never commercial in its current line; tools/run.py misses stock issued for services as stock pay (raised again, as at SCWO). Write-early: three commits (template, Step 0 and foundations, the rest after Q1 closed). Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; no E-ids, every id in the ledger, 4 adjacent fragment pairs checked by `dispatcher_cite_check.py`, none flagged (the analyst's own check: 16 ids); no tracked research file over 200 KB; raw filings in the ignored cache. Contamination declared: commit subjects of two other companies' overnight runs, queue-state lines in the map and memory index, company names in .gitignore comments and in the framework's tests; none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Not armed: the box is not OUT at Q7 or IN.
runs.narr: OUT at Q1: a pre-commercial battery-recycling developer (AquaRefining), lead demonstration plant closed, lithium pilot only, no revenue in 2024 or 2025, a going-concern doubt, funding by share sales after two reverse splits, and a failed Lion Energy deal with $4.1M advanced; computation only, owner cash negative every year, value about -$77.95 a share. Not armed.
